correctness.rationale: The commutator algebra is symplectic Heisenberg. Idempotent morphisms preserving its central derived line are exactly identity; other idempotents have isotropic-image projection P with central functional h on im P. Witt decomposition K=(K intersect W-perp) orthogonal sum K1 yields a nondegenerate 2(m-r) block plus alternating rank 2s on dimension r. Symplectic group transitivity is proved by explicit compatible pairings, and central shears eliminate h. For fixed W, graph maps A and B parametrize all complements, and B-B^T is onto Alt_r with q^{r(r+1)/2} fibers, including characteristic two; counting alternating forms of rank 2s yields exact orbit sizes. Two independent small-case scripts reproduce binary orbit counts and ternary direct defining equations.

originality.rationale: The claim is an exact orbit stratification under pre-automorphism conjugation by both image dimension and symplectic kernel rank, with a transitivity theorem and orbit-size formula. Published abstract ideal/complement correspondences and earlier exact rank marginals do not specify or imply the split between nonconjugate fixed-rank retractions. In the first split, the two rank-two binary orbits have opposite Lie-kernel abelianness. Actual primary-text, mathematical-record, and historical-claim checks identified no dominating orbit theorem; publication priority remains provisional.

value.rationale: This gives a complete uniform conjugacy-orbit classification for natural idempotent pre-endomorphisms, not merely previously known rank totals. The first nontrivial five-dimensional case has two rank-two orbits whose kernels are structurally distinct (abelian versus nonabelian); the formula gives their exact masses and all higher-dimensional analogues, directly enabling symmetry-aware stabilizer calculations.
